scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src scripts tests workers/api/src workers/api/tests && node scripts/check-architecture.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @noor/web typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p workers/api/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @noor/web test && pnpm test:backend
scripts.test:backend: node --experimental-strip-types --test workers/api/tests/*.test.ts && python3 -m unittest discover -s workers/api/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
